storyboards.title: Under the Streetlights
storyboards.summary: Wet asphalt doing the work. She passes through pools of sodium light and the walk reads as ordinary rather than cinematic.

shots.purpose: Place her in the light-and-dark rhythm of the street.
shots.description: Medium wide of Jung Haewon walking toward camera on a wet residential street, streetlight pools on the asphalt, reflections breaking under her steps.

sample_request.raw_user_prompt: Jung Haewon walks home under streetlights after rain.

scene_spec.location: wet residential street after rain, night
scene_spec.activity: walking toward camera through pools of streetlight
scene_spec.lighting: sodium streetlights overhead with wet-asphalt reflections

storyboards.title: Reflection First
storyboards.summary: The reflection carries the shot and she enters it late. Riskier to render, which is exactly why it should be sampled cheaply first.

shots.purpose: Let the puddle carry the image before she does.
shots.description: Low-angle shot of a puddle holding an inverted streetlight, Jung Haewon entering the top of frame in a dark coat, footfall about to break the surface.

scene_spec.location: wet residential street after rain, night

scene_spec.camera: low angle close to the ground, puddle filling the lower two thirds
